# design/tomi/ — Tomi visual identity

The symbol "the loop": an open ring with a bead in its opening. Identity colours: night `#24324A` and sun `#FFC85C`.
Start with [`brand-guidelines.md`](brand-guidelines.md), the brand guidelines.

**Do not edit by hand** except `brand-guidelines.md` and `tokens.json`. The shapes come from
[`../build/tomi-geometry.mjs`](../build/tomi-geometry.mjs); all SVGs and everything under `export/` are regenerated by `tomi-export.mjs`.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`brand-guidelines.md`](brand-guidelines.md) | The brand guidelines: idea, construction, optical sizes, animation, logotype, colours and contrast, typography, icons, tone, rules for developers. |
| [`tokens.json`](tokens.json) | Source of truth for the values: colours, type scale, spacing, radii, motion. Token names are shared with the Android, Windows and Apple apps. Colour identity tokens: `color.identity.night`, `color.identity.sun`; motion tokens: `motion.logo.*`. |
| [`logo.svg`](logo.svg) | The symbol, viewBox 256, `currentColor`. Use from 32 px up. |
| [`logo-16.svg`](logo-16.svg), [`logo-20.svg`](logo-20.svg), [`logo-24.svg`](logo-24.svg) | The symbol drawn pixel by pixel (`crispEdges`), each only at its exact size. |
| [`logo-app.svg`](logo-app.svg), [`logo-app-16.svg`](logo-app-16.svg), [`logo-app-20.svg`](logo-app-20.svg), [`logo-app-24.svg`](logo-app-24.svg) | App icon (night tile, sun symbol), vector and then pixel-drawn. |
| [`logo-wordmark.svg`](logo-wordmark.svg) | The "tomi" wordmark alone, drawn letters. |
| [`logo-horizontal.svg`](logo-horizontal.svg), [`logo-stacked.svg`](logo-stacked.svg) | Symbol + wordmark lockups, `currentColor`. |
| [`logo-horizontal-on-night.svg`](logo-horizontal-on-night.svg) | Colour lockup (sun + white), on night background only. |
| [`logo-anime.svg`](logo-anime.svg) | Animation demo (the bead's lap, in CSS; disabled by `prefers-reduced-motion`). |
| [`export/`](export/) | Ready-to-use icons: Windows `tomi.ico`, `tray-light` / `tray-dark` (`.ico` and PNG 16/20/24/32); Android `android/ic_stat_tomi.xml` and `ic_launcher*.xml`; Google Play `store/tomi-play-512.png`. |
| [`proofs/`](proofs/) | Edge renders at real size (`*-actual.png`) and enlarged (`*-x8.png`, `*-x4.png`, `*-x3.png`), referenced by the guidelines. |

## Commands

From `design\build` (Node 22 and Microsoft Edge required; `EDGE_PATH` for a different Edge location; `npm ci` once):

```powershell
cd design\build
npm ci
node tomi-export.mjs                              # SVG + export/ ; exit code 1 if a check fails
node tomi-contrasts.mjs                          # contrast tables ; exit code 1 if a pair fails
node tomi-proofs.mjs                             # proof renders in proofs/
node tomi-build-pdf.mjs                           # local PDF/HTML of the guidelines (see below)
node verify-pdf.mjs ..\tomi\brand-guidelines.pdf  # embedded fonts, pages rendered to build\apercu\tomi\
```

`tomi-export.mjs` checks: pixel renders are crisp (alpha 0 or 255 only) and use no colour other than the requested ones,
renders are not empty, `.ico` files are read back entry by entry, the adaptive icon sits inside the 66 dp safe circle,
and colours match `tokens.json`.
If you change a colour: update `tokens.json` and `NIGHT` / `SUN` in `tomi-geometry.mjs`, then run `tomi-contrasts.mjs`
and copy its tables into section 4.3 of the guidelines.

**Generated PDF (not versioned).** `tomi-build-pdf.mjs` renders `brand-guidelines.md` into a print layout and writes
`build/tomi-brand-guidelines.html` and `tomi/brand-guidelines.pdf` locally, using Microsoft Edge in headless mode. Both outputs are
git-ignored; regenerate them when needed. Run `tomi-export.mjs` and `tomi-proofs.mjs` first.

Dependencies (already pinned in `build/package-lock.json`): `@resvg/resvg-js` 2.6.2 (PNG rendering), `markdown-it` 15.0.3, `pdf-to-img` 7.0.2.
